metadata.title: Investigation of SWEET family sugar transporter genes and their role in arbuscular mycorrhiza

entities.name: MlSWEET1a
entities.description: Candidate gene for specific expression in the leaves of the mycorrhized host plant.

entities.name: MlSWEET1b
entities.description: Candidate gene for specific expression in the leaves of the mycorrhized host plant.

entities.name: MlSWEET2c
entities.description: Candidate gene for specific expression in the roots.

entities.name: increased productivity of aboveground biomass
entities.description: Inoculation with AMF increased the productivity of aboveground biomass.

entities.name: accelerated plant development
entities.description: Inoculation with the AMF accelerated plant development under low phosphorus level.

entities.name: lower roots/shoots ratio
entities.description: The roots/shoots ratio of mycorrhized plants was lower than in plants without mycorrhiza.

relations.mechanism: Gene expression analysis suggests MlSWEET1a is a candidate gene for specific expression in the leaves of the mycorrhized host plant; inoculation increased aboveground biomass productivity.
relations.growth_stage_detail: during plant development up to the inflorescence phase
relations.evidence: Gene expression analysis suggests that genes MlSWEET1a ... are candidates for specific expression in the leaves of the mycorrhized host plant; An inoculation of M. lupulina with the AMF increased the productivity of aboveground biomass and accelerated plant development.

relations.mechanism: Gene expression analysis suggests MlSWEET2c is a candidate gene for specific expression in the roots; mycorrhized plants had a lower roots/shoots ratio than plants without mycorrhiza.
